---
title: "Airbnb — Explorateur Mondial"
subtitle: "75 villes · 30 pays · Inside Airbnb juin 2025"
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    scrolling: true
    theme: cosmo
resources:
  - helpers/pbnbdash-util-helper.js
  - helpers/pbnbdash-util-helper.css
  - helpers/pbnbdash-maplibre-helper.js
  - helpers/jcn-scatterojs.js
  - helpers/jcn-tableojs.js
  - helpers/ddict-airbnb.json
include-in-header:
  text: |
    <link href="https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@3.6.2/dist/maplibre-gl.css" rel="stylesheet">
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@3.6.2/dist/maplibre-gl.js"></script>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="helpers/pbnbdash-util-helper.css">
    <script src="helpers/pbnbdash-util-helper.js"></script>
    <script src="helpers/pbnbdash-maplibre-helper.js"></script>
    <!-- scatter + table = ES modules, importés via import() dans OJS -->
    <style>
      /* Monde dashboard — overrides (teal header distinct du navy France) */
      .top-block-header { background:#0d6a5e !important; }
      .bslib-page-title { background:#0d6a5e !important; color:white !important; padding:8px 16px !important; }
      .navbar .navbar-title, .navbar-brand { font-weight:700 !important; }
      h2.anchored { margin-top:0 !important; padding-top:0 !important; }

      /* Row 1 — KPI + Top hosts grid */
      .kpi-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:3.5fr 0.8fr; gap:0; height:100%; }
      .kpi-panel { display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:white; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; }
      .kpi-header {
        background:#0d6a5e; color:white; padding:6px 16px; font-size:12px;
        display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
      }
      .kpi-blocs { display:flex; flex:1; min-height:0; }
      .kpi-bloc { flex:1; padding:10px 14px; border-right:1px solid #e5e7eb; overflow-y:auto; }
      .kpi-bloc:last-child { border-right:none; }
      .kpi-bloc-title {
        font-size:10px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.5px;
        padding-bottom:4px; margin-bottom:6px; border-bottom:2px solid;
      }
      .kpi-item { margin-bottom:8px; }
      .kpi-item .kv { font-size:20px; font-weight:800; display:inline; }
      .kpi-item .kl { font-size:12px; color:#374151; display:inline; margin-left:6px; }
      .kpi-item .kt { font-size:8.5px; color:#475569; margin-top:2px; line-height:1.3; }
      .kpi-item .kt .u { color:#0d6a5e; } .kpi-item .kt .d { color:#ca5800; }
      .kpi-narr { margin-bottom:8px; font-size:11px; line-height:1.4; color:#374151; }
      .kpi-narr strong { font-size:13px; font-weight:800; }
      .hosts-panel {
        background:#f8f9fa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-left:none;
        display:flex; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden;
      }
      .hosts-panel .hosts-hd {
        font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:#374151; padding:6px 12px;
        background:#e5e7eb; border-bottom:1px solid #d1d5db;
      }
      .hosts-panel .hosts-scroll { overflow-y:auto; flex:1; }
      .hosts-panel table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:10px; }
      .hosts-panel th {
        position:sticky; top:0; background:#e5e7eb; padding:3px 6px;
        text-align:left; font-size:9px; font-weight:600; color:#374151;
      }
      .hosts-panel td { padding:2px 6px; border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9; }

      /* Row 2 — Maps + Scatter grid */
      .r1-grid {
        display:grid; grid-template-columns:25fr 40fr 35fr; grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;
        gap:2px; height:100%; min-height:460px; background:#d1d5db;
      }
      .r1-ctrl {
        background:white; padding:6px 12px;
        display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; font-size:11px;
      }
      .r1-ctrl select { font-size:11px; padding:3px 6px; border:1px solid #94a3b8; border-radius:3px; }
      .r1-ctrl label { font-weight:600; color:#0d6a5e; font-size:11px; }
      .r1-cell { position:relative; background:#e8e8e8; overflow:hidden; }
      .r1-cell .cell-lbl {
        position:absolute; top:4px; left:4px; z-index:5;
        background:rgba(255,255,255,0.88); padding:2px 8px; font-size:10px;
        font-weight:600; color:#0d6a5e; border-radius:3px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      }

      /* Scatter zoom controls */
      .scatter-zoom-ctrl {
        position:absolute; top:8px; right:8px; z-index:10;
        display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px;
      }
      .sz-btn {
        width:26px; height:26px; border:1px solid #94a3b8; border-radius:3px;
        background:white; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; font-weight:700;
        color:#374151; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
        box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      }
      .sz-btn:hover { background:#f1f5f9; }

      /* Main layout tweaks */
      .card-body { justify-content:flex-start !important; align-items:flex-start !important; padding-top:4px !important; }
      .cell-output-display { align-self:flex-start; width:100%; }
    </style>
    <!-- JS externalisé dans helpers/pbnbdash-maplibre-helper.js + scatter-helper.js -->
execute:
  warning: false
  echo: false
freeze: auto
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)

# Load KPI CSV (75 villes)
kpi <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/vince/hh/pq/PDS/pbnb-airbnb-log-jrr-jpy/data/interim/kpi_global_by_city_2506.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Coordonnées par ville (from city-reference)
city_ref <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/vince/hh/pq/PDS/pbnb-airbnb-log-jrr-jpy/data/external/city-reference-airbnb-260217.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Merge coords
kpi <- kpi |>
  left_join(city_ref |> select(city, lat, lon), by = "city") |>
  rename(latitude = lat, longitude = lon)

# Agrégats globaux
total_listings <- sum(kpi$n_listings, na.rm = TRUE)
total_cities <- nrow(kpi)
total_countries <- length(unique(kpi$country_code))
total_continents <- length(unique(kpi$continent))
prix_med_global <- round(median(kpi$prix_med_entire, na.rm = TRUE), 0)
pct_multi_global <- round(weighted.mean(kpi$pct_multi, kpi$n_listings, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
pct_entire_global <- round(weighted.mean(kpi$pct_entire, kpi$n_listings, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
density_med_global <- round(median(kpi$listings_1000hab, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
rating_med_global <- round(median(kpi$rev_rating_med, na.rm = TRUE), 2)

# Rankings top 3 / bottom 3 pour 4 indicateurs clés
make_ranking <- function(df, col, n = 3, desc_order = TRUE) {
  df <- df |> filter(!is.na(.data[[col]]))
  if (desc_order) df <- df |> arrange(desc(.data[[col]]))
  else df <- df |> arrange(.data[[col]])
  top <- head(df, n) |> select(city_fr, country_code, val = !!sym(col))
  bot <- tail(df, n) |> arrange(.data[[col]]) |> select(city_fr, country_code, val = !!sym(col))
  if (!desc_order) { tmp <- top; top <- bot; bot <- tmp }
  list(top = top, bot = bot)
}
rk_prix <- make_ranking(kpi, "prix_med_entire")
rk_density <- make_ranking(kpi, "listings_1000hab")
rk_multi <- make_ranking(kpi, "pct_multi")
rk_note <- make_ranking(kpi, "rev_rating_med")
cr10_global <- round(weighted.mean(kpi$cr_top10_pct, kpi$n_listings, na.rm = TRUE), 1)

# Nouveaux agrégats
n_hosts_total <- sum(kpi$n_hosts, na.rm = TRUE)
revenue_med_global <- round(median(kpi$revenue_est_med, na.rm = TRUE), 0)
dispo_med_global <- round(median(kpi$dispo_med, na.rm = TRUE), 0)
cr_hosts_50pct_global <- round(weighted.mean(kpi$cr_hosts_50pct, kpi$n_listings, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
cr_host_10plus_global <- round(weighted.mean(kpi$cr_host_10plus, kpi$n_listings, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
cr_offre_10plus_global <- round(weighted.mean(kpi$cr_offre_10plus, kpi$n_listings, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
cr_offre_5plus_global <- round(weighted.mean(kpi$cr_offre_5plus, kpi$n_listings, na.rm = TRUE), 1)

# Top 10 hosts globaux (depuis parquet sumlistings)
top_hosts <- tryCatch({
  df_sum <- arrow::read_parquet(
    "C:/Users/vince/hh/pq/PDS/pbnb-airbnb-log-jrr-jpy/data/interim/dbsumlistings_2506_cons_global.parquet",
    col_select = c("host_id", "host_name", "city", "id"))
  total_global <- nrow(df_sum)
  h <- df_sum |>
    summarise(
      host_name = first(host_name),
      n_listings = n(),
      n_cities = n_distinct(city),
      .by = host_id) |>
    arrange(desc(n_listings)) |>
    head(10) |>
    mutate(pct_offre = round(n_listings / total_global * 100, 2))
  h
}, error = function(e) { data.frame() })

# ojs_define
ojs_define(kpi_data = kpi)
ojs_define(total_listings = total_listings)
ojs_define(total_cities = total_cities)
ojs_define(total_countries = total_countries)
ojs_define(total_continents = total_continents)
ojs_define(prix_med_global = prix_med_global)
ojs_define(pct_multi_global = pct_multi_global)
ojs_define(pct_entire_global = pct_entire_global)
ojs_define(density_med_global = density_med_global)
ojs_define(rating_med_global = rating_med_global)
ojs_define(cr10_global = cr10_global)
ojs_define(n_hosts_total = n_hosts_total)
ojs_define(revenue_med_global = revenue_med_global)
ojs_define(dispo_med_global = dispo_med_global)
ojs_define(cr_hosts_50pct_global = cr_hosts_50pct_global)
ojs_define(cr_host_10plus_global = cr_host_10plus_global)
ojs_define(cr_offre_10plus_global = cr_offre_10plus_global)
ojs_define(cr_offre_5plus_global = cr_offre_5plus_global)
ojs_define(rk_prix_top = rk_prix$top)
ojs_define(rk_prix_bot = rk_prix$bot)
ojs_define(rk_density_top = rk_density$top)
ojs_define(rk_density_bot = rk_density$bot)
ojs_define(rk_multi_top = rk_multi$top)
ojs_define(rk_multi_bot = rk_multi$bot)
ojs_define(rk_note_top = rk_note$top)
ojs_define(rk_note_bot = rk_note$bot)
ojs_define(top_hosts_data = top_hosts)
```

//| label: row1-kpi-hosts
{
  const data = transpose(kpi_data);
  const hosts = transpose(top_hosts_data);
  const DD = window.DDICT || {};

  // Helpers
  const fv = (v, key) => {
    if (v == null || isNaN(+v)) return "\u2014";
    const n = +v;
    const dd = DD[key] || {};
    if (key === "rev_rating_med") return n.toFixed(2) + "/5";
    if (dd.type === "pct") return n.toFixed(1) + "%";
    if (dd.type === "prix") return Math.round(n).toLocaleString("fr-FR") + "\u00a0\u20ac";
    if (n >= 1000) return Math.round(n).toLocaleString("fr-FR");
    if (n % 1 !== 0) return n.toFixed(1);
    return String(Math.round(n));
  };
  const cn = (d) => {
    const name = d.city_fr || d.city || "";
    return name.length > 13 ? name.substring(0, 11) + "\u2026" : name;
  };
  const tb3 = (key) => {
    const valid = data.filter(d => d[key] != null && !isNaN(+d[key]));
    const sorted = [...valid].sort((a, b) => +b[key] - +a[key]);
    return { top: sorted.slice(0, 3), bot: sorted.slice(-3).reverse() };
  };
  const tbLine = (arr, key, cls) => arr.map(d =>
    `<span class="${cls}">${cls === "u" ? "\u25b2" : "\u25bc"}</span>${cn(d)} ${fv(d[key], key)}`
  ).join(" \u00b7 ");

  // Tooltip DDICT
  const tip = (key) => {
    const dd = DD[key] || {};
    return (dd.desc || dd.label || "").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
  };
  const info = (key) => {
    const t = tip(key);
    return t ? ` <span title="${t}" style="cursor:help;opacity:0.35;font-size:8px;">\u24d8</span>` : "";
  };

  // KPI item inline (value + label on same line)
  const kItem = (key, val, label, color) => {
    const r = tb3(key);
    return `<div class="kpi-item">
      <span class="kv" style="color:${color};">${val}</span>
      <span class="kl">${label}${info(key)}</span>
      <div class="kt">${tbLine(r.top, key, "u")} \u00b7 ${tbLine(r.bot, key, "d")}</div>
    </div>`;
  };

  // Narrative item (for concentration section)
  const kNarr = (html) => `<div class="kpi-narr">${html}</div>`;

  // Format globals
  const fN = (n) => Math.round(n).toLocaleString("fr-FR");

  const d = document.createElement("div");
  d.className = "kpi-grid";
  d.innerHTML = `
  <div class="kpi-panel">
    <div class="kpi-header">
      <span>Synth\u00e8se des m\u00e9triques clefs</span>
      <span style="font-size:10px;opacity:0.7;">Source : Inside Airbnb, juin 2025 \u00b7 ${total_cities} villes \u00b7 ${total_countries} pays</span>
    </div>
    <div class="kpi-blocs">
      <div class="kpi-bloc">
        <div class="kpi-bloc-title" style="border-color:#0d6a5e;color:#0d6a5e;">March\u00e9</div>
        ${kItem("n_listings", fN(total_listings), "annonces actives", "#0d6a5e")}
        ${kItem("n_hosts", fN(n_hosts_total), "h\u00f4tes distincts", "#0d6a5e")}
        ${kItem("pct_entire", pct_entire_global + "%", "logements entiers", "#0d6a5e")}
        ${kItem("listings_1000hab", density_med_global, "ann. / 1\u202f000 hab (m\u00e9d.)", "#0d6a5e")}
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-bloc">
        <div class="kpi-bloc-title" style="border-color:#ca5800;color:#ca5800;">Prix & Activit\u00e9</div>
        ${kItem("prix_med_entire", fN(prix_med_global) + "\u00a0\u20ac", "par nuit \u2014 logement entier (m\u00e9d.)", "#ca5800")}
        ${kItem("rev_rating_med", (+rating_med_global).toFixed(2) + "/5", "note m\u00e9diane", "#55b748")}
        ${kItem("revenue_est_med", fN(revenue_med_global) + "\u00a0\u20ac", "revenu annuel estim\u00e9 (m\u00e9d.)", "#ca5800")}
        ${kItem("dispo_med", dispo_med_global + " j", "disponibilit\u00e9 m\u00e9diane /an", "#0d6a5e")}
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-bloc">
        <div class="kpi-bloc-title" style="border-color:#6d1a36;color:#6d1a36;">Professionnalisation</div>
        ${kItem("pct_multi", pct_multi_global + "%", "multi-h\u00f4tes (>1 annonce)", "#6d1a36")}
        ${kNarr(`<strong style="color:#6d1a36;">${cr_host_10plus_global}\u202f%</strong> des h\u00f4tes g\u00e8rent \u226510 annonces \u2014 soit <strong style="color:#6d1a36;">${cr_offre_10plus_global}\u202f%</strong> du total des offres${info("cr_offre_10plus")}`)}
        ${kNarr(`<strong style="color:#6d1a36;">${cr10_global}\u202f%</strong> de l\u2019offre d\u00e9tenue par les 10 plus gros h\u00f4tes${info("cr_top10_pct")}`)}
        ${kNarr(`<strong style="color:#6d1a36;">${cr_hosts_50pct_global}\u202f%</strong> des h\u00f4tes suffisent pour d\u00e9tenir 50\u202f% de l\u2019offre${info("cr_hosts_50pct")}`)}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="hosts-panel">
    <div class="hosts-hd">Top 10 h\u00f4tes mondiaux</div>
    <div class="hosts-scroll">
      ${hosts && hosts.length ? `<table>
        <thead><tr>
          <th>#</th><th>H\u00f4te</th><th style="text-align:right;">Ann.</th>
          <th style="text-align:right;">Villes</th><th style="text-align:right;">%</th>
        </tr></thead>
        <tbody>${hosts.slice(0, 10).map((r, i) => {
          const name = (r.host_name || "ID:" + r.host_id).substring(0, 22);
          const bg = i % 2 === 0 ? "" : "background:#f8f9fa;";
          return `<tr style="${bg}">
            <td style="color:#94a3b8;">${i+1}</td>
            <td style="font-weight:500;max-width:100px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${name}</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;font-weight:700;color:#0d6a5e;">${Math.round(r.n_listings).toLocaleString("fr-FR")}</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;color:#1696d2;">${Math.round(r.n_cities)}</td>
            <td style="text-align:right;color:#ca5800;">${(+r.pct_offre).toFixed(2)}%</td>
          </tr>`;
        }).join("")}</tbody>
      </table>` : `<div style="padding:12px;color:#94a3b8;font-size:11px;">Donn\u00e9es non disponibles</div>`}
    </div>
  </div>`;
  return d;
}

//| label: row2-maps-scatter
{
  const allData = transpose(kpi_data);
  const DD = window.DDICT || {};
  const europe = allData.filter(d => d.continent === "Europe");
  const metrics = typeof WORLD_METRICS !== "undefined" ? WORLD_METRICS : [];
  let currentMetric = "listings_1000hab";

  // Grid container: ctrl-maps (col 1-2) + ctrl-scatter (col 3) / maps + scatter
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.className = "r1-grid";

  // Shared indicator selector for maps (col 1-2)
  const mapCtrl = document.createElement("div");
  mapCtrl.className = "r1-ctrl";
  mapCtrl.style.gridColumn = "1/3";
  const selHtml = metrics.map(m => {
    const dd = DD[m.key] || {};
    const label = dd.short || m.label || m.key;
    return `<option value="${m.key}" ${m.key === currentMetric ? "selected" : ""}>${label}</option>`;
  }).join("");
  mapCtrl.innerHTML = `<label>Indicateur</label>
    <select class="qm-sel">${selHtml}</select>
    <div class="qm-legend" style="flex:1;"></div>`;
  wrap.appendChild(mapCtrl);

  // Scatter controls (col 3) — labels medium from DDICT
  const scCtrl = document.createElement("div");
  scCtrl.className = "r1-ctrl";
  const optH = (sel) => metrics.map(m => {
    const dd = DD[m.key] || {};
    return `<option value="${m.key}" ${m.key === sel ? "selected" : ""}>${dd.label || dd.short || m.label || m.key}</option>`;
  }).join("");
  scCtrl.innerHTML = `<label>X</label><select id="sx">${optH("cr_offre_10plus")}</select>
    <label>Y</label><select id="sy">${optH("cr_host_10plus")}</select>
    <span style="margin-left:4px;">
      <label style="font-size:10px;"><input type="radio" name="smode" value="Villes" checked> Villes</label>
      <label style="font-size:10px;margin-left:4px;"><input type="radio" name="smode" value="Pays"> Pays</label>
    </span>`;
  wrap.appendChild(scCtrl);

  // Map cells (Monde + Europe)
  const regions = [
    { label: "Monde", data: allData, center: [10, 25], zoom: 1.0, pad: 8 },
    { label: "Europe", data: europe, center: [12, 50], zoom: 3, pad: 3 }
  ];
  const mapDivs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const cell = document.createElement("div");
    cell.className = "r1-cell";
    const lbl = document.createElement("div");
    lbl.className = "cell-lbl";
    lbl.textContent = regions[i].label + " (" + regions[i].data.length + ")";
    cell.appendChild(lbl);
    const md = document.createElement("div");
    md.style.cssText = "width:100%;height:100%;";
    cell.appendChild(md);
    mapDivs.push(md);
    wrap.appendChild(cell);
  }

  // Scatter area (col 3)
  const scatterArea = document.createElement("div");
  scatterArea.style.cssText = "background:white;overflow:hidden;position:relative;";
  wrap.appendChild(scatterArea);

  yield wrap;
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120));

  // Fake features for irisBins
  const fakeFeats = allData.map(d => ({ properties: Object.assign({ n: 999 }, d) }));

  const fitBbox = (data, pad) => {
    const lats = data.map(d => +d.latitude).filter(Boolean);
    const lngs = data.map(d => +d.longitude).filter(Boolean);
    if (!lats.length) return null;
    return [[Math.min(...lngs) - pad, Math.min(...lats) - pad],
            [Math.max(...lngs) + pad, Math.max(...lats) + pad]];
  };

  // Create 2 maps
  const maps = [];
  const loadPromises = regions.map((reg, i) => new Promise(resolve => {
    const bbox = i === 0 ? null : fitBbox(reg.data, reg.pad);
    const mapOpts = {
      container: mapDivs[i],
      style: "https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/positron-gl-style/style.json",
      center: reg.center, zoom: reg.zoom,
      minZoom: 1, maxZoom: 14,
      attributionControl: false,
      cooperativeGestures: true,
      dragRotate: false, pitchWithRotate: false, touchPitch: false,
      fadeDuration: 0
    };
    // Monde: disable renderWorldCopies + maxBounds to keep view world-wide
    if (i === 0) {
      mapOpts.renderWorldCopies = false;
      mapOpts.maxBounds = [[-180, -60], [180, 75]];
    }
    const map = new maplibregl.Map(mapOpts);
    map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl({ showCompass: false }), "top-right");
    map.on("load", () => {
      if (bbox) map.fitBounds(bbox, { padding: 15, duration: 0 });
      const geo = {
        type: "FeatureCollection",
        features: reg.data.map(d => ({
          type: "Feature",
          geometry: { type: "Point", coordinates: [+d.longitude || 0, +d.latitude || 0] },
          properties: Object.assign({}, d)
        }))
      };
      map.addSource("cities", { type: "geojson", data: geo });
      const maxL = Math.max(...reg.data.map(d => +d.n_listings || 0));
      map.addLayer({
        id: "circles", type: "circle", source: "cities",
        paint: {
          "circle-radius": ["interpolate", ["linear"],
            ["sqrt", ["/", ["to-number", ["get", "n_listings"], 0], maxL || 1]],
            0, 3, 0.2, 6, 0.5, 12, 1, 20],
          "circle-color": "#1696d2",
          "circle-opacity": 0.82,
          "circle-stroke-color": "white",
          "circle-stroke-width": 1
        }
      });
      let pop = null;
      map.on("mousemove", "circles", (e) => {
        const p = e.features[0].properties;
        map.getCanvas().style.cursor = "pointer";
        if (pop) pop.remove();
        const html = typeof buildCityTooltip === "function"
          ? buildCityTooltip(p, allData, "monde") : "<b>" + (p.city_fr || p.city) + "</b>";
        pop = new maplibregl.Popup({ offset: 10, closeButton: false, closeOnClick: false, className: "city-popup-dark" })
          .setLngLat(e.lngLat).setHTML(html).addTo(map);
      });
      map.on("mouseleave", "circles", () => {
        map.getCanvas().style.cursor = "";
        if (pop) { pop.remove(); pop = null; }
      });
      maps.push(map);
      resolve();
    });
  }));

  await Promise.all(loadPromises);

  // Update maps with indicator colors
  function updateAll(k) {
    currentMetric = k;
    const dd = DD[k] || {};
    const mInfo = metrics.find(m => m.key === k) || { label: dd.short || k, unit: dd.unit || "" };
    const bins = irisBins(fakeFeats, k, "niveau", null);
    if (!bins) return;
    const step = stepEx(k, bins.brk, bins.col);
    step[1] = ["to-number", step[1], 0];
    maps.forEach(map => {
      map.setPaintProperty("circles", "circle-color", [
        "case", ["==", ["get", k], null], "#b0b0b0", step
      ]);
    });
    const legDiv = mapCtrl.querySelector(".qm-legend");
    legDiv.innerHTML = "";
    legDiv.appendChild(buildLegend(bins, mInfo.label, fakeFeats, k, null));
  }
  updateAll(currentMetric);
  mapCtrl.querySelector(".qm-sel").addEventListener("change", (e) => updateAll(e.target.value));

  // Scatter with zoom
  const scatterMod = await import(new URL("helpers/jcn-scatterojs.js", document.baseURI).href);
  const scatterCtrl = scatterMod.createScatterWithZoom({
    Plot, d3, data: allData, container: scatterArea,
    xCol: "cr_offre_10plus", yCol: "cr_host_10plus", mode: "Villes",
    axisLabelMode: "medium"
  });
  scCtrl.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const xKey = scCtrl.querySelector("#sx").value;
    const yKey = scCtrl.querySelector("#sy").value;
    const mode = scCtrl.querySelector("input[name='smode']:checked").value;
    scatterCtrl.update(xKey, yKey, mode);
  });

  setTimeout(() => maps.forEach(m => m.resize()), 300);
}
